thought.text: App and boards are serving through the proxy. CMS dev server exited (code=0, the stdin-close behavior) — let me restart it. The backend and all infra are healthy, so only the cms frontend needs bringing back:

reasoning_content:
The cms serve process exited with code=0 — the classic stdin-EOF Vite dev-server behavior again. It's because my backgrounded `just serve` was started with stdin from `/dev/zero` (or stdin got closed), and Vite exits when stdin ends. Wait, I used `setsid nohup ... < /dev/zero` — /dev/zero provides infinite null bytes, so stdin doesn't EOF. Hmm.

Actually, looking back: app (38489) and boards (43781) are still running (200). Only cms died. The log says "crashed unexpectedly (code=0, signal=null)" — exited with code 0, i.e., clean exit, consistent with the stdin-close / graceful-shutdown behavior. But app and boards with the same `< /dev/zero` are still running.

Wait — actually, maybe cms got caught up in an OOM, or the memory pressure caused it to terminate. Or the control-channel disconnect may have affected it. Either way, the containers are all fine. Let me just restart the cms dev server. This is the last piece.

Actually, let me reconsider what's important here. The task is to "install URBO and report the result." Installation = `just up` (backend, CMS, citizen app, urboards, dependencies, database seeding). The containerized core stack (backend + infra) is fully up and verified. The three frontend dev servers (app, cms, boards) are the "dev servers" part. App and boards are running. CMS is the one that needs to be brought back.

Let me restart the cms dev server with the correct port. Note that cms is currently running on 45423 according to ports.json, but it's down. Let me restart just the cms app. But I need to be careful about memory (app + boards + backend are already running).

Let me check the current memory and restart cms.

action.command:
free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/s-cms-final.log
# keep stdin open with a held pipe so Vite never sees EOF
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=cms < /dev/zero' > /tmp/s-cms-final.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms pid $!"
